protocol: scripts/evaluate_wake.py on the A1 fixtures (396: 76 positive, 320 negative) plus 3600 s silence

before.config: packaged keyword line: no boost, threshold 0.25

sweep_a1.extra_variant_line: HH EY1 G IH1 D IY0 N

sweep_lab_clips.corpus: private lab clips (51 positive, 54 negative; pinned in docs/evidence/wake-live-pins.json)
sweep_lab_clips.method: scripts/wake_live_regression.py: one continuous stream in the live lab order, production engine; hits per repeat (3 or 6 repeats, lead and gaps seeded)
sweep_lab_clips.boost_1_2_threshold_0_22_warm3_cond_auto: 44.3 mean over 6 repeats (44, 44, 43, 44, 42, 49), 0 false; 0 false in 66 min of real noise
sweep_lab_clips.boost_1_2_threshold_0_22_warm0_cond_auto: 41.3 mean (36, 41, 47): the warm-up is what keeps the spread small
sweep_lab_clips.boost_1_4_threshold_0_22_warm3_cond_auto: 45.2 mean over 6 repeats, 1 false (the babble clip) in 1 of 6: rejected
sweep_lab_clips.note: Earlier figures 49/51 (packaged) and 51/51 (boost 1.2) were not reproduced by this harness; their script is not in the repository. They are not used as evidence.

limits: Tuning used the same synthetic corpora that measure it; the lab clips are not an independent holdout.
Four Kokoro voices and one Pocket voice; no human speech, no room or device measurement.
Live hit rate on the owner microphone is not measured here (A7 pending human validation).
